description: Irreversibly destroy a retained onion identity's parked recovery copies on its current host and the platform reservation. Only a prior identity after rotation or an uninstalled deployment's stale identity may be purged, never a live deployment's current address. Wait for agent success to confirm deletion on the current host; prior exports and external backups are unaffected. Released mode clears records only and does not verify key deletion. Requires manage scope, explicit confirmation of the exact retained confirm_address and, in agent mode, onion-purge-v1. If confirm_token is absent from this connection's input schema, use a connection that exposes it or a supported customer-portal flow. A quote or confirmation request is not completion. IRREVERSIBLE — takes two calls: the first returns a confirm_token and changes nothing, the second repeats the same arguments plus confirm_token and executes.

confirm_address.description: The retained .onion address being destroyed, verbatim.
